in_marathi.name: Nashit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nashit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nashati' meaning 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a heroic deity who protects the virtuous from evil.
